limitations: Historical enumeration began under the retired Python wrapper and continued under Rust; the original WASM package and source identity remained frozen throughout
All retained capacity summaries are included, including failed and deliberately interrupted phases; successful later phases do not turn earlier failures into passes
Growth observations describe checksummed private prefixes; completeness is established by the final full checkpoint proof
Whole-directory samples include shared qualification data, runtime files and temporary workspace; private-generation part bytes are a narrower metric
The capacity cap is a sampled operating guard, not a hard filesystem quota or a guarantee for the unavailable customer account list
Current-package continuation, full paginated read/export/restore and hot-state retention remain separately measured acceptance steps
